paragraphs: R' Chanina Tritaa. See the entry R' Chanina Horteya,[^1]

notes.text: Tritaa (טריטאה) and Horteya (הורתייא) are tentative vocalizations. The supplied notice ends in a comma after the complete target name; its full original extent is not established. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
